meta.source: Stephen-Gehring-Daimler.pdf (InDesign, US Letter). Print sizes converted at 1pt = 1.333px.

tokens.name: brand-cyan
tokens.usage: The signature colour. Full-bleed header band behind the logo, eyebrow, headline and pull quote. Set `ink` or `ink-body` on it, never white.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground below the header band.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, section heads, labels, logo, footer, and pull quotes. Reads on `surface` (21:1) and `brand-cyan` (16:1).

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Montserrat running text, contact details and sidebar lists on `surface` (11.4:1). The source also carries near-identical #36383b, #37393b and #373b3e; treat them as this token.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary half of a heading line: the role after the company (`Palo Alto Networks — Senior UX/UI Designer`) and date ranges. On `surface` only (6.1:1).

tokens.name: accent-dash
tokens.usage: The em-dash marker that leads each career entry. Decorative only: 1.7:1 on `surface` misses the 3:1 floor for meaningful marks, so never use it for text, icons or anything that carries meaning on its own.

tokens.name: rule-hairline
tokens.usage: Horizontal dividers between sections and around inline testimonials, at `border-hairline` width.

tokens.name: rule-divider
tokens.usage: The vertical column rule and the footer rule, at `border-rule` width.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Header band headline. All caps, `ink` on `brand-cyan`, three short lines.

styles.name: section-head
styles.usage: Section headings in the main column. All caps, `ink`.

styles.name: subhead
styles.sample: DESIGN SYSTEMS / VISUAL DESIGN / CREATIVE LEADERSHIP
styles.usage: Specialty line under `title`, slash-separated, all caps.

styles.name: entry-company
styles.usage: Company name that opens a career entry, `ink`, title case.

styles.name: entry-role
styles.usage: Role or project after the company, `ink-muted`, joined by an em dash. Also date ranges.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.sample: PRODUCT DESIGN / UX & UI / DESIGN SYSTEMS / MOTION
styles.usage: Discipline line in the header band, right of the logo. All caps, slash-separated.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Sidebar and contact-block labels. All caps, `ink`.

styles.name: footer
styles.usage: Running footer: name left, SGEHRING.COM right, above a `rule-divider` line.

styles.name: pull-quote
styles.sample: Steve is a rare breed—results-driven, and a fiercely talented creative designer.”
styles.usage: Header testimonial, `ink` on `brand-cyan`, under a large opening quote mark.

styles.name: detail
styles.usage: Contact block values under a `label`, `ink-body`. Light (300) for secondary address lines.

styles.name: body-sans
styles.sample: Experienced UX/UI designer and creative leader specializing in complex digital experiences.
styles.usage: Resume running text and entry descriptions, `ink-body`.

styles.name: list-item
styles.usage: Sidebar lists (core skills, tools, contact), one item per line, `ink-body`.

styles.name: attribution-role
styles.usage: Author's title and company under `attribution-name`. Caps in the header; sentence case at 300 weight inline.

styles.name: body-serif
styles.sample: Throughout my career, I’ve worked across complex technology environments.
styles.usage: Cover-letter running text, `ink`. Paragraphs separated by `space-paragraph`.

styles.name: quote-serif
styles.sample: “Steve is relentless in his pursuit of clean, usable and elegant designs.”
styles.usage: Inline testimonial inside letter text, between two `rule-hairline` lines.

tokens.name: space-indent
tokens.usage: Indent from the em-dash marker to entry text, and again to bullets.

tokens.name: space-paragraph
tokens.usage: Extra space between paragraphs and between contact blocks.

tokens.name: space-gutter
tokens.usage: Gap between the main column and the sidebar rule.

tokens.name: band-height
tokens.usage: Height of the `brand-cyan` header band on letter and resume first pages.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything is square: bands, rules, blocks. No rounded corners.

tokens.name: border-rule
tokens.usage: Vertical column rule and footer rule in `rule-divider`.
